Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game. India have now won three games in a row in this tournament and have booked their place in the final. Bangladesh, on the other hand, have everything to play for against Sri Lanka as the winner will join India in the final. That game will be played on the 16th of March in Colombo at 1900 local (1330 GMT). Till then, take care and cheers!

Man of the Match and India captain, Rohit Sharma, says it was important for him to step up as he had mentioned in the toss. He felt they were 10-15 runs short and credits the way Bangladesh bowled in the death. Appreciates Washington Sundar's spell at the start. Reckons the wicket was on the slower side as it was gripping and turning. Further adds it was not easy to play the shots and hence he took his time. States the partnership between him and Suresh Raina was key. Acknowledges the courage shown by Sundar as he provided them with the wickets when they needed it. Ends by saying Mohammed Siraj is a great talent and he has the skills to execute what the captain asks for.

Bangladesh captain, Mahmudullah, says he is disappointed with the effort. Credits Mushfiqur Rahim for the way he batted. He feels the chase was on and they needed a good start which they did not get. Reckons 10 runs less would have made a difference. Mentions the plan in the death overs was to take the pace off and stick to their strengths but it did not work out for them. Ends by saying they have an opportunity to prove themselves in the next game and they are looking forward for it.

For India, Washington Sundar was the pick of the bowlers with a three-fer. He was well supported by Chahal and the two combined to end with figures of 8-0-43-4. Siraj, however, once again had a day to forget. He did pick a wicket towards the end but was taken for 50 runs in his 4 overs. Nevertheless, a good victory for India. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Chasing 177 was never going to be easy on a wicket which was a little sluggish and the start for Bangladesh was also not good. They lost the accelerator of their last game, Liton Das, early. Tamim Iqbal though continued playing his shots and got the Bangla Tigers off to a flier. However, Washington Sundar spun a web around the opposition batsmen as he picked up three big wickets in the Powerplay. Mahmudullah did show intent after coming on but he fell prey to another spinner, Chahal. Then Sabbir and Rahim joined forces and did provide hope with a 65-run stand, but once the former departed it was too much of an ask for Rahim who once again notched up a fifty and remained unbeaten.

India are into the finals with another victory over Bangladesh, who are yet to win a T20I game against the Men in Blue. It was all set up by their skipper Rohit Sharma who played an outstanding knock in the first innings and then their bowlers followed it up and ensured they come out on top.
A dot to finish and INDIA WIN BY 17 RUNS! Another slower ball outside off, Rahim goes to cut but misses.
A slower ball outside off, Rahim lets it be thinking it is a wide but it has not been called.

FOUR! This is brilliant by Rahim! It, however, won't make any difference to the result of the game. Take nothing away from his innings though. A full ball outside off, driven through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! A bumper which bounces way above the batsman's head and the umpire signals it a wide.
FOUR! Up and over! Still won't be enough though! A short ball on middle, Rahim upper cuts it across the third man fence for a boundary.
Abu Hider Rony to bat next.

OUT! In the air... taken! Something to rejoice for Siraj as he gets Miraj. He bowls a knuckle ball on middle and on a length. Hasan had to go for the biggie and he does so. He however, does not connect well and lobs it up in the air towards long off where Raina does not drop it.
Shorter in length on middle, Rahim tries to guide it through third man but only gets one for it.

Again only a run! Take a bow, young man. He got hit for 19 in his first and still finishes with 4-0-37-1. And to add to that, just 5 from the penultimate over. A wide yorker outside off, squeezed towards point for a run. 27 needed of 6. Five sixes are needed to win this game.
Just a single again! 28 more needed! This is exceptional stuff from Thakur. He bowls it on a length around off, Rahim slaps it through covers for a run.
The batsman has taken the risk and lofted it over the covers. They pick up a single.
A full ball at a good speed on middle, hit down the ground for a run.
Excellent, excellent stuff from Thakur. He was taken to the cleaners in his first over but has come back really well. A slower ball outside off, Rahim goes across the line but does not connect.
Wide outside off, eased through covers for a brace.

FOUR! Hasan takes full toll of the Free Hit! The night keeps getting worse for Siraj. He concedes 16 from this one. Bowls it wide outside off, Hasan slices it over point and there is no fielder in the deep and the ball races away. 33 now in 12.
Free Hit coming up!

No ball it is! Siraj bowls a high full toss which Rahim mistimes and hits it straight up in the air towards the bowler who takes a catch. However, he has a chance of a run out as Rahim goes for a run and is way short. He though misses his shy at the non-striker's end and the batsmen complete a run. The umpires are not sure about the no ball and they go upstairs to check. The replays show the ball to be above the waist and it is given in the favor of the batsman.
They have gone to check upstairs for the no ball for height. If it is not one Rahim has been caught and bowled but it seems a little high to me. A tough call for the umpire.

A short ball, a surprise one on middle. Rahim tries to upper cut but misses. He just needed to get bat to that one but could not. The third man fielder was up and he could have fetched himself another boundary.
Good length mistimed towards mid off and the batsmen go for a run. Raina lines it up and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
On a length around off, cut through point for a run.

FOUR! Well, if he keeps striking it like this, he surely can! Excellent by the wicket-keeper batsman. He paddles the length ball over the keeper's head for a boundary. Two in two balls, 8 from the first two.

FOUR! Siraj is welcomed with a boundary! He has had a day to forget so far. Short and wide outside off, Rahim cuts it through point and the ball races away. He also brings up his 4th T20I fifty and it is also back-to-back fifties for him. The question here is though, can he pull a rabbit out of the hat?
Mohammed Siraj is back into the attack.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Guided through point for a run.
Mehidy Hasan is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Shardul Thakur gets the wicket which probably seals the game and the spot in the final for the Indians. A brilliant slower ball on off, it stays a touch low. Sabbir had to go for it and he goes across the line. He misses it completely and the ball kisses the off pole. Shardul is off for a celebratory run as he has broken the 65-run stand. Nevertheless, a good knock by Sabbir comes to an end but his team needed him to be there till the end. 51 needed of 20.
Fuller on off, guided it through point for a brace.
FOUR! A much, much-needed boundary. A short ball on off, Sabbir picks the length early and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another dot! They are just swinging blindly. A full ball outside off, Sabbir comes down the track and throws the kitchen sink at it but only manages to connect with thin air.
Shardul Thakur back into the attack.

Just a couple to end this over. Brilliant bowling! 4 runs from the over. He tosses this one up on off, Rahim goes over the bowler's head for a brace. That also ends Washington Sundar's spell. His figures read 4-0-3-22. OUTSTANDING!
Brilliant by the youngster! He bowls a yorker outside off and inside the tramline. Rahim tries to go after it but misses.
Rahim brings out the reverse sweep, Sundar slows it up. Rahim misses the reverse sweep. Another dot, Sundar is taking the game away from Bangladesh.
Just 2 from the first 3 balls. Sundar tosses it up to Rahman who slices it through point for a run. Something has got to give now.
A low full toss on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Fires it wide outside off, Rahim mistimes it towards cover for a run.
Washington Sundar to bowl out. Can he break this partnership before he's done with the ball tonight?
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total. 61 in 30. Two tight overs for India. Bangladesh need a big one now.

Clever bowling! Bowls it slow once again on middle, Sabbir goes down on one knee and tries to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. He then sets off for a run but is sent back by Rahim. The bowler who is appealing on his followthrough, turns and then picks the ball up and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been interesting.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down the track and gets a full toss. Sabbir mistimes it and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

What an effort by Shardul Thakur, great commitment by the fast bowler especially after bowling the over before this one. Sabbir charges down the track and gets a ball on the leg stump. He goes for the flick but the ball takes the top edge and goes towards backward square leg region. Thakur in the deep runs to his right, dives but can't get to it. He though does well to stop it on the bounce. The batsmen take two and that also brings up the fifty run stand.
A good slower one on off, Rahim waits for it and strokes it through covers for a run.
Vijay Shankar is back on.
Excellent over, just 5 from it! Short and outside off, cut towards point for a run. 2 short of 70 needed now in 36 deliveries.

That has been hit hard but straight to the fielder! Short and on the stumps, Rahman walks down the track and pulls it with disdain but towards the deep mid-wicket fielder who misfields but does not concede an extra run.
Another single! Excellent stuff from Thakur. He bowls it full and wide outside off, Rahim squeezes it through point for a run.
Slower ball on middle, Rahim is early into the flick and he gets a soft leading edge towards the bowler. More importantly a dot.
Shortish outside off, chopped towards point for another run. Two from the first two balls.
Good length on off, guided down to third man for a run.
Shardul Thakur is back on. He went for 19 in his previous over. Can he pull it back?

SIX! An excellent end to the over for Bangladesh! 10 from this one also. A poor ball, a half-tracker on middle, Sabbir rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 73 in 7 overs to win for Bangladesh.
Comes down the track, seeing that Chahal bowls it slower and wide. Sabbir guides it to point for no run.
Rahim makes room and tries to go over the off side this time. He though gets a bottom edge which hits the keeper and goes down towards short third man for a run.
Once again plays the sweep to a ball which is way outside off, towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Goes for the sweep but it goes off the arm towards short third man for a leg bye.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back into the attack.
Two is the call and they get it easily! 14 from this over. Fuller ball on middle, Rahim works it away with soft hands through mid-wicket and bags a brace.
Smart from Sabbir this time. He got a boundary in the previous delivery. Keeps his composure on this one and taps it towards cover for a quick run. 12 runs from this over so far.
FOUR! Rahman is on the charge now! He dances down the track, gets it short on his hips. He pulls it with authority through backward square leg for a boundary.
Good bowling! A very slow ball on off, Rahim pushes it through point for a run.
A couple to follow! Good batting, he flicks this full ball in the gap through mid-wicket and gets a brace. 6 from the first two. They need something around 11 in each over.
FOUR! Ideal start to the over! A full and wide ball outside off, Rahim slaps it over covers and there is no stopping that ball. Early boundary in the over, pressure on the bowler now.
A dot to finish! But 16 from the over. On a length around off, kept out. 97 needed now from 54.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
SIX! BOOM BOOM GOES RAHIM! 15 from the over till now! Rahim once again uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid off for a maximum.
WIDE! The pressure is getting to Siraj here. He bangs it short on middle, Rahim lets it go and the umpire signals a wide. Siraj is not a happy man as he feels that was okay.

FOUR! Cleverly done! Siraj lands it on a length around off, Rahim makes a little room and opens the face of the bat late. The ball goes fine towards third man and into the fence. Back-to-back boundaries. Is this the big over Bangladesh need?
FOUR! A much-needed one! A boundary after 22 balls. Rahim comes dancing down the track, gets a short ball and he pulls it hard over mid-wicket. They need a lot more.

Was there an edge? A lot of the Indians felt so but Karthik did not appeal! Siraj starts off really well by landing it on a length around off, it straightens a touch. Rahim tries to defend but he seems to have missed it. There is though a noise as the ball passes the bat. The players appeal but the umpire remains put. Replays later on show that the bat had hit his front pad, good decision by the umpire.
Mohammed Siraj is back into the attack.
Back of a length, around off, Sabbir opens the face of the bat and dabs it to backward point.
Full in length and outside the line of off stump, Rahim mistimes the drive towards mid off. Takes on Dhawan there and beats his shy at the non-striker's end. Good running.
Pounds it short, into the body, pulled away by Sabbir to deep square leg. He jogs across to the other end and rotates strike.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Rahim drives this on the up down towards mid off. Dhawan there, moves swiftly to his right and makes a good tumbling stop. Just a single taken.
Full and well outside off, Mushfiqur comes down the track looking to connect, but misses it altogether.
Goes full and attacks the stumps, it goes off the inner half in front of square leg as the batsmen take a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Terrific over from Chahal, 4 runs and a wicket from it.
Landed on middle, spinning away a touch, Rahman is forward in defense.
Sabbir Rahman is the next batsman in.

OUT! Mahmudullah's little cameo comes to an end. Shorter in length on the stumps, Mahmudullah camps back and pulls it over mid-wicket looking to clear the fence. Doesn't connect well at all, and it's a simple catch for KL Rahul out in the deep who comes in a few steps and pouches it.
Superb delivery. Leg break around off, spins as Mahmudullah closes the face to work it across the line. It goes off the leading edge and down to short third man.
Full on the pads, swept through square leg for one run.
Wide! Outside off and across the other side of the tramline again, wide signalled.

That was close! Chahal almost catches it. Tossed up outside off, Mahmudullah hammers it back down. Chahal moves to his left, but it's hit too hard for him to reach it. Just a single taken as the ball goes down to long off.
Wide! Turning away from wide outside off, goes across the tramline as the batsman has nothing to do with it. Wide called.
Just ahead of a length, gets it to move away a little. Mahmudullah guides it towards short third man to keep strike.
Hits the length hard on off, kept out.
Length ball on middle, pushed down to long on to change strike.
Shortish and wide outside off, Rahim guides it towards point where Rahul dives to his left and saves a couple at least.
Fullish on the pads, Mahmudullah works it around the corner. The batsmen thought about the second but it was not on.
A slower full ball on middle, eased down to long on for an easy run.
Vijay Shankar is into the attack.
Goes against the spin and works it away on the leg side, through mid-wicket for a single.
The wrong 'un, on a bit of a shorter length, spins back in and catches Rahim on the thigh pad.
Doesn't use his feet to this one and plays it out safely.
Loopy leg spinner around off, driven to the covers for nothing.

FOUR! Lovely, innovative stuff from Rahim! He premeditates the reverse sweep, gets low and executes the shot to perfection. Sundar at backward point leaps to try and take the catch, but can't get his hand to it and stop the boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries to end the over! Mahmudullah charges out and smacks it over mid off for a boundary. Despite this, it's been an excellent over from Washington. A wicket and 9 runs from it. Bangladesh finish the Powerplay on 48/3, while India were 49/0 at the end of it.
FOUR! Freebie to get off the mark! Short and wide, Mahmudullah cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Mahmudullah to bat next.

OUT! Third wicket in his third over! Young Washington Sundar is ripping through the Bangladesh batting line-up. And the Powerplay isn't even over yet. He's got the big fish this time. Bowls it quicker and flatter on middle, it keeps angling down, Tamim moves inside to play the slog sweep but misses it completely and the ball takes the leg bail after that. India rejoice, they know this could be their moment.
Flatter ball sliding in on leg, the left-hander backs away and punches it away to the covers.

Was that out? It looks like it in real time. Oh dear... could it be? No review left, India might be hard done by on this. Drifts in at first from around the wicket and then spins away, beats the hanging bat of Tamim Iqbal and catches him on the back pad. The umpire shuts down the lbw appeal, possibly height an issue? Not sure, but either way, Tamim survives.
Leg break on the stumps, driven through the covers for one.
Defended solidly from inside the crease. End of a decent over from the leggie.

Excellent stop from Rohit Sharma. Had he not saved that, it would have been a certain boundary. Full and outside off, Rahim drives it towards the covers where the Indian skipper dives to his right and keeps the batsmen to just a single.
Plays with the spin and works it through mid-wicket to get off strike.
Lbw appeal turned down! Remember, there's no review left for India to take. Tossed up googly on off, catches Iqbal low on the pads who looks to sweep it away.
Stays right behind the line of this one and blocks it out with the full face of the bat.
Looped up on the stumps, driven down to long off for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is on to bowl.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Picks it off the pads and worked away on the leg side.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Second in as many overs for Washington Sundar. The kid is pulling off yet another magical performance in the Powerplay. After that beating in the previous over, this is just what India needed. A tidy over and a vital wicket. From around the wicket, it's bowled full. It drifts in as Sarkar goes for a heave. He misses and the bails are knocked off. Bangladesh need 142 to win off 98 balls.
Flatter on the stumps, angling in, it's whipped away through the mid-wicket region for a run.
Wide! Darted down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
Another full ball, another drive down through mid on for a run.
Fuller and straighter on the stumps, it's eased down to long on for a single.
19 runs off the over. Single off the final ball. Worked away on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! 18 off the over so far. Tamim is on fire here. Thakur is being taken for a ride. Just behind a length, it's pulled hard over mid-wicket for one more boundary.
SIX! This has gone all the way! Poor bowling from Shardul though, he needs to get his radar right. Down the leg side, Tamim moves inside the line and lifts it over fine leg for a maximum.
FOUR! Two in two for the opener! Full again, wide outside off, Tamim throws the kitchen sink at it and crashes it square through the off side this time for another boundary.
FOUR! That's a glorious shot! Fuller in length and well outside off, Iqbal thrashes it through the gap in the covers to find the fence.
Short of a good length outside off, punched off the back foot into the off side.
Shardul Thakur is into the attack.
The batsman delicately works it fine down the leg side.
Soumya Sarkar is in at No.3.

OUT! Sundar picks up a wicket in his first over again. 50th T20 stumping for Dinesh Karthik. Das gives the charge once more and this time the bowler darts it wide outside off. Das swings across the line but is beaten on the inside. The ball goes into the mitts of the keeper who takes the bails off with ease.
FOUR! Great shot! Seeing the batsman give the charge, Sundar drags it wide. But the batsman still hits it across the long off fence for a boundary.
Tossed right up there, blocked off the front foot with the full face of the bat.
Straighter one on the stumps, worked away on the leg side.

Not out! Wasted review to be honest. Looked clearly not out to the naked eye to begin with. Das gives the charge to this loopy full toss. Misses and is hit high on the thigh pad. Appeal goes up, but nothing from the umpire. The impact is outside off and the batsman is way down the track, but for some reason the review is taken. Maybe Dinesh Karthik asks to take it. It goes upstairs and replays show the batsman is clearly safe. Poor call. The review should never have been taken.
And the review is taken. Drama on the first ball of Sundar's spell. Liton Das is the man in question, looks quite safe, but let's see what happens here...
Washington Sundar will bowl from the other end.
Touch wide outside off, guided behind point, down towards third man for a run. Decent first over for the Tigers, 8 off it.
Nicely done. Fraction straight in line, Liton Das is off the mark with a brace as he works it through mid-wicket.
Just behind a length, around off, Tamim walks down to hit but gets it off the bottom edge towards cover, where a misfield from KL Rahul allows the batsmen to take a single.
Camps back to this good length ball and keeps it out with the full face of the bat.
FOUR! And he cuts loose! Doesn't waste time in doing so. Short of a good length close to off, Tamim is up on his toes as he slashes this hard over point to find the fence.
Back of a length around off, Tamim cuts hard but straight to the man at point.
We are back for the chase. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das will open the innings for Bangladesh, while Mohammed Siraj will take the ball first up. A slip in place for him. Here we go...
